title: Martha Gardens
description:

One of the joys of gardening is planning for beautiful color all through the year; bulbs and tubers are at the center of this show because of their beautiful blooms from spring to winter.

The basic elements of making a stew; beef stew; veal stew; coq au vin.

Blanching, steaming and roasting vegetables.

Making fresh pasta by hand and with a machine; shaping dough into farfalle and tortelli.

description:

Traditional pasta sauce; slow-cooked Bolognese; puttanesca; carbonara; a light sauce made with bottarga.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S2 E7 — Fishmonger
Seafood chef Dave Pasternack explains buying, butchering and storing fish; boning a round or flat fish; cleaning a squid; crudo.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S2 E8 — Sauteing
Dredging meat or fish in flour, then cooking over high heat to ensure a golden-brown finish; wiener schnitzel; chicken piccata; sole a la meunière; pan sauces.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S4 E2 — The Art of Raw Food
Martha and Omar Abou-Ismail make miso soup and a bean-free hummus with flatbread made with raw ingredients; Martha and Omar whip up a tabouli salad followed by sweet potato fries.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S4 E3 — Baking Baguettes and Breads
Martha tours Breads Bakery with owner Gadi Paleg and learns about their award-winning baked goods; Martha and bakers make Breads Bakery's baguette, challah, and egg sandwich.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S4 E4 — Chef David Burke's Modern Classics
Chef David Burke brings his modern classic dishes to Martha's kitchen; a bacon clothesline, calamari noodles, miso chicken with ginger and vegetables, and key lime pie are on the menu.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S4 E5 — All Things Yogurt
Homa Dashtaki, owner of the White Moustache yogurt company, shares her technique for making yogurt, Persian rice with a yogurt dip, and whey pancakes.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S5 E2 — Japanese Knife Skills
Martha takes a deep dive into how to choose and maintain the best knives; Chef Masa Takayama shares his superior knife skills and world renowned dishes.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S5 E4 — Arethusa Farm Dairy's Award Winning Cheese
Martha road trips to Arethusa Farm in Bantam, CT, and learns how they make their award-winning Europa cheese, visits their cheese caves, and makes their delicious cheesy risotto recipe.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S5 E8 — The Science of Woks and Frying
Martha and Chef Kenji Lopez-Alt make extra-crunchy fried chicken sandwiches, tempura shrimp with vegetables, and finally a perfectly stir-fried beef with broccoli.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E2 — The Perfect Jams to Pair With a Simple Breakfast
One of Martha's favorite things to do is to make jam with the perfectly ripened fruit and berries grown on her Bedford farm; Martha shares her favorite recipes, as well as jam and jarring techniques.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S2 E1 — Martha's Easy Foundation Landscaping Project
Martha redesigns the foundation landscaping around one of the homes on her Bedford Farm, providing step-by-step instructions on how to complete a successful landscaping project with ease and intent.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S2 E2 — Growing Citrus
Martha explores the incredible world of citrus from yuzus and kumquats to citrons and mandarins; Martha visits Flavors by Bhumi in her home state of New Jersey to learn all about growing citrus.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S2 E3 — Getting the Garden Going
Martha prepares her garden for the season's splendor - from planting hellebores to propagating trees to proper lawn care; plus, succulent pots for early color.
